Green’s motion graphics/title design and directing work with being primarily “known for animation.” This overgeneralization relied on a snippet without weighing primary recognition and failed to select a single filmmaker as required (Lev Yilmaz is explicitly known for animation via his “Tales of Mere Existence”).
